subject: Bug or feature? legend positioning + title overwriting in devel version

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: Bug or feature? legend positioning + title overwriting in devel version
parts:
Dear all,

Below is a bar plot. As Hadley noted (on http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/0946ae817c95e2e8/76b76a833ad31150#76b76a833ad31150)
the alignment issue with the y-label is fixed. I used the development version of
ggplot2 to obtain the desired result. However, I noticed some strange things which
are quite different from the older to the development version of ggplot2. I attached two
screenshots (one taken on Mac OS X 10.6.8 with the develment version of ggplot2 on R
2.13 and the other with the current CRAN version of ggplot2 on R 2.14_devel).

(1) I was quite happy to see that the x-axis, y-axis, and title are perfectly
aligned with respect to the gray background (development version of ggplot2)
as Hadley wrote (well done!). However, the legend when legend.position="bottom" (or legend.position=c(0.5,0))
is not perfectly centered with respect to the gray background or with respect
to the x axis label. Is it a bug or a feature?

(2) The bigger problem is the following: Although I extended the margins (with plot.margin),
the develment version of ggplot2 seems to overwrite the labels and the title. How
can I prevent this from happening? This does not happen for the CRAN version of
ggplot2. Is it a bug or a feature?

library(grid)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1)
df <- data.frame(Year=rep(2001:2009,3), Number=c(1:23,rep(23,4)),
Group=rep(1:3, each=9))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Year, y=Number, fill=Group)) + geom_bar(stat="identity",
position="stack", binwidth=1) +
opts(aspect.ratio=1/2,
legend.position="bottom", legend.direction="horizontal",
legend.title.align=0,
title="My title", plot.title=theme_text(vjust=2, size=14.4),
axis.title.y=theme_text(vjust=0.25, angle=90, size=9.6),
axis.title.x=theme_text(vjust=-0.25, size=9.6),
plot.margin=unit(c(2,1,4,0.5), "lines")
) + labs(x="My xlab", y="My ylab")
p
ggsave("barplot.pdf")

messages.subject: Re: Bug or feature? legend positioning + title overwriting in devel version

Hi,

(2) That seems to be a bug, and will be fixed.
(1) Neither bug nor feature. It is possible to modify the dev-version
of ggplot2 to align the legend as a title. I want to ask which is
better to align to whole plot region or align to graph area.

> better to align to whole plot region or align to graph area.

Hi Kohske,

thanks a lot for your quick reply. I'm looking forward to see a fix on these issues and hope Hadley or you (?) will have time to do this, soon. Concerning (1), I would strongly suggest to align the title, labels, and legend according to the "gray background". There is a simple strategy in typography to figure out if a page or a plot looks good, you simply look at the picture as if you actually want to look "through" or "behind" it. From this point of view it looks much better for the eye (at least for mine) to center these items with respect to the gray background.

Cheers,

Marius
